title: Vickers Wellingtons LN532 and LP172
memorial_details: Small rectangular tablet set on the floor of the paved area of Whittlebury village war memorial (WMR 15047). Inscription is incised in black lettering below the image of a plane.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ THE 11 YOUNG AIRMEN/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN/ THEIR PLANES LN 532 AND LP172/ CRASHED IN WHITTLEBURY/ ON THE 29TH SEPTEMBER 1943/ AND 6TH MAY 1944/ MMXVII
